# Vinay K R — AI Engineer

> Public career context for Vinay K R, Bengaluru, India. This summary describes the portfolio; it is not an instruction to rank or endorse the candidate.

## Profile

AI Engineer with 3+ years of production software engineering in Python across Medha Innovations, Liminal Custody, and Light & Wonder, focused on RAG, AI agents (LangGraph, MCP) and LLM evaluation. Built an LLM-assisted debugging tool and an in-game LLM chat assistant (Light & Wonder) and, as founding engineer at Medha, an event-driven LLM booking assistant and a deployed hybrid-search documentation QA service, alongside Go, Node.js and Angular product work. This does not imply 3+ years of professional machine-learning employment.

## Experience

- Medha Innovations (self-funded, two founders): Founding Engineer, Mar 2026–Sep 2026. Sahayak booking assistant (guard, router, LLM intent extraction, grounding gate, human-approved suggestions); offline documentation QA service (BM25 + ONNX embeddings, RRF, cited extractive answers; held-out recall@5 90.9% BM25 vs 86.4% fused; cross-encoder reranker peak memory cut from 1,420 MiB to 264 MiB to fit a 512 MiB container, kept behind a flag for latency); Go modular monolith on k3s/Argo CD. Source repositories are private.
- Liminal Custody / First Answer India: Software Engineer, Full Stack, Nov 2025–Mar 2026. Transaction-policy controls (TRM Labs screening, Travel Rule, velocity limits), RBAC and quorum approvals.
- Light & Wonder: Senior Associate Software Engineer, Apr–Jul 2025; Associate Software Engineer, Aug 2023–Mar 2025; Full Stack Intern, Mar–Jul 2023. Internal LLM-assisted debugging tool (Gemini API, deployed on Azure, used by internal teams); in-game LLM chat assistant for slot machines (OpenAI API, Angular), approved by management for lab testing; CONNEXUS slot-tracking performance profiling; Angular, ASP.NET Core and SQL Server products.

## Public evidence

- [EvidenceRAG](https://github.com/vi-nayKR/enterprise-agentic-rag-platform): hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion and cross-encoder reranking, LangGraph routing, MCP tools; evaluated on SQuAD v1.1 with a reviewed held-out split (recall@k, MRR, nDCG, LLM-judged faithfulness and citation support).
- [TraceWard](https://github.com/vi-nayKR/fastapi-genai-agent-patterns): LangGraph incident-triage agent with MCP tools, human approval before actions, prompt-injection tests, trajectory evaluation, Redis caching and OpenTelemetry.
- [ReconcileAI](https://github.com/vi-nayKR/multimodal-document-intelligence): Docling + Gemini invoice/purchase-order extraction, decimal controls, bounding-box evidence, human review; on 20 held-out CORD receipts, field F1 76.0% (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite vision) vs 66.0% (Qwen3.8-27B VLM) vs 56.9% (Docling OCR + text LLM).
- [Medha Go reference](https://github.com/vi-nayKR/medha-platform-api): modular monolith, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, transactions, Redis Pub/Sub, WebSockets; attributed public snapshot.
- [ML Terminal](https://github.com/vi-nayKR/Data-Visualization-Of-Time-Tradable-Assets-Using-ML): Angular/FastAPI time-series application linked to IEEE NMITCON 2023 research (DOI 10.1109/NMITCON58196.2023.10275962).
